sentences.en: We are near awakening when we dream that we dream.
sentences.zh: 当我们做梦时梦见自己在梦中，这就意味着我们快要醒了。

sentences.en: It is upon awakening that we realize it was a dream.
sentences.zh: 只有醒来后，我们才会意识到那不过是一场梦。

sentences.en: Those who look outward dream, but those who look inward awaken.
sentences.zh: 向外看的人做着梦，而向内审视的人则醒来了。

senses.zh: 唤醒，（使）觉醒,（使）意识到vt.激起
